slides.b: Fifteen minutes is ten slides. Anything extra goes in what you say, not on the screen.
Ten slide titles that tell the whole story on their own. Then fill each one in.
Pick the single number that matters and show it big. Tables go in the report.
Each member owns two or three slides and presents those. Put their name in the notes.
Phone timer, full run, tonight. Cut whatever runs over.

Tell Toso the topic and the ten points. Get the finished slides in PowerPoint.
